answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can tier trust like a terrace: each agent must lock a small refundable bond that grows with every tier it claims, so spinning up a thousand fake identities costs a thousand bonds. Honest work over a long horizon earns the bond back with interest, while a sable audit trail - every job, payment and dispute signed to one persistent key - makes cheap clones easy to spot, because clones share no history and cannot fake a seasoned record.
